applicabilityBasis.summary: The tracked ZeUSD is the legacy collateralized-debt token, not a replacement stablecoin or zVault share. Archived official mechanics and verified router code describe minting against RWA collateral and repayment/burning of a recorded position to recover underlying assets. General payment/settlement marketing exists, but these sources do not establish the legal issuer obligation to redeem every token for fixed monetary value required by section 2. RWA/securities collateral alone does not prove the token itself is an excluded security.

genius.notes: Assessment follows the tracked legacy ZeUSD contract and does not transfer newer Zoth product rights, licenses or jurisdictions onto it. Metaco Intelligence Corporation is named as website operator; exact token issuer and domicile remain unresolved and are omitted. General infrastructure roadmap language is below the token-specific issuer-announced-intent threshold. Reserve and attestation flags are omitted because a current, product-scoped disclosure for legacy ZeUSD was not recovered. Not-yet-restricted records GENIUS timing only, not general lawful sale. The archived deployment list identifies the tracked 0x7DC9748DA8E762e569F9269f48F69A1a9F8Ea761 token under deprecated infrastructure and a separate V2 token. The Intellistake release is third-party reporting, not a filing by the ZeUSD legal issuer.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 7 October 2026, the opened Zoth terms, current website/blog, archived ZeUSD mechanics and Intellistake filing, scoped regulator-site searches for Zoth, ZeUSD and Metaco Intelligence, the opened federal framework notices and New York directory yielded no public ZeUSD-specific GENIUS issuer authorization or official application. The 2025 corporate filing describes GENIUS-compliant infrastructure direction, without an issuer approval plan, pathway or token-contract linkage sufficient for issuer-announced-intent. Partner Paxos supervision and Canadian/offshore provider licenses do not establish ZeUSD authorization. This finding is limited to public sources checked; no non-compliance or universal absence claim is made. The independent verifier reopened the cited framework and issuer sources and repeated the named regulator-domain search on 2026-10-07 without finding token-specific approval or application evidence.
